name: @kroma/module-tools
description: The module author's CLI: scaffold a module, expand a single-file `*.module.md` into its crate, validate every manifest, pack a `.kmod`, and decide what CI publishes. `@kroma/module-tools/registry` is the RFC-110 registry contract itself: zod schemas, the document builders, and a typed client any conforming registry answers.
author: Maxime Scharwath <maxscharwath@gmail.com>
